description_en: Update the name and description of a card instance.
description_zh: 更新卡实例的名称和描述
name: UpdateCard

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G cloud instance.
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ICCID of the Internet of Things (IoT) card.
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.  
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:  
true: Sends a dry run request without updating the card information. The system checks whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.  
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the card information is updated.
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新卡信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后更新卡信息
parameters.name: dry_run
